title: Ten scattered flushes keep 'no runs wait when anything but running text touches the ui', and is_running_text shadows the dispatch
why: The ten sites are exactly as listed (nine set_runs, one show_runs). Two claims need correcting. Tag::Superscript and Tag::Subscript cut no seam today: the fork's parser_options enables tables, task lists, strikethrough, footnotes and definition lists only (egui_commonmark_backend/src/pulldown.rs:268-273), plus math and YAML metadata (latex_delimiters.rs:149-152), so those events never arrive. And the three drain loops are not identical: the two inside horizontal_wrapped (2857-2868, 2905-2916) are, the third (2990-3002) also intercepts block quotes and sets self.upcoming. By grep, the only emitters outside the running arms are the heading end (4163-4171) and the HTML fallback (4299-4318), both of which flush, so the second flush at 3506 does look redundant; that needs the debug_assert and a run.
size: 1 file, about 60 lines; one helper for the two identical loops
guards: tests/reader/line_breaks.rs (16), vendor/.../tests/touching_runs.rs (5) and the reader suite for paint order. No app-crate gate reads vendor/. Put the debug_assert in first and run both suites before dropping the flush at 3506.

title: Where text goes is decided by three if-chains over the same four fields, and link_is_active shadows self.link
why: text_waits (3708-3713), emit_text (3790-3819) and end_link (3693-3703) test image, code block, heading and table in the same order and must agree; the three highlight closures at 3839, 3939 and 3953 repeat && !self.text_waits(). I checked the link cases: a match in a link in a table or a heading is recorded where it is emitted, one in a paragraph link through link_is_active, so a TextSink enum keeps all of them. Moving the capture into emit_text is the uncertain half and can be left out.

title: epaint holds the word-boundary rule twice and a test keeps the copies equal
why: is_word_boundary (text_layout.rs:1002-1011) and RowBreakCandidates::add (1055-1070) state the same three conditions. I checked the proposed single-field form arm by arm, the non-breaking space and a CJK character before closing punctuation included: it is equivalent, and word_boundary only ever reads the three fields as their maximum. The cost is a larger difference from upstream in a patched copy, and the painter's own tests run in no CI job (26-F7b).
size: 1 file, about 35 lines, one test of 45 lines deleted
guards: test_room_after_* (4), test_first_word and upstream's wrapping tests in the same file, none run by CI; every reader test that wraps prose.

title: The run code is a self-contained unit added to a 6,400-line file
why: Run, RUN_ROUNDING, width_of_start, keep_room_for_touching_runs and the touches rule in join_run are about 110 lines with one dependency on the viewer (pulldown.rs:1866-1924, 3715-3730). One change to the sketch: show_runs takes the Vec, drains it and puts it back to keep its capacity ('Emptied, and kept for the room it has', 3766-3767), so a take_with_room that returns a fresh Vec would allocate per paragraph per frame. Hand out a draining iterator or a slice instead.
size: 2 files (new parsers/runs.rs, pulldown.rs) and mod.rs; about 110 lines moved
guards: Same tests as 26-F1. More than 100 lines leave pulldown.rs in one commit: it is a move, so make it a commit of its own (refactoring rules).

title: HeadingPiece is Run under another name, and set_runs wraps a one-off boolean
why: The heading end converts each HeadingPiece to a Run and calls show_runs(ui, cache, false) (4149-4171); set_runs only passes true (3734-3736). Merging the two changes what is painted when a formula or picture sits in a heading, and where a find match in a multi-row heading is recorded, as the review says; the in-file test at 6091 reads current_heading_pieces.
observable: If merged: a formula or picture in a heading would be painted after the text before it, not before the whole heading; a find match in a long heading would scroll to its own row.
size: naming only: 1 file, about 8 lines. Merge: about 50 lines and one in-file test rewritten
guards: tests/reader/line_breaks.rs list_items_quotes_and_headings_keep_them_together_too; heading and outline reader tests; in-file heading_display (6088-6098).

options.name: Name the boolean now and leave the heading alone
Fold heading text into the runs in a follow-up PR

options.cost: Nothing; true and false stay at the call sites.

title: room_after does not say what it means with a row limit, centred or justified text
why: The doc comment (text_layout_types.rs:436-444) states the default and the effect and nothing about max_rows, alignment or justify. No caller combines them today.

observable: Text that touches the end of a long code span starts on a new row.
guards: tests/reader/code.rs and the cell-height predictor (cell_visual_lines) that mirrors per-piece wrapping in tables.
